parent_lead_untrusted: [INFERENCE, parent arithmetic only] VR = BK = 126 and Lambda(V-1) = 52 = rho1(K-1)+2rho2(K-2). With G = M^T M, MM^T = 7I+4J, GJ = 63J, H := 63I - 9G + 28J satisfies H^2 = 63H, H1 = 0, trace 252, rank 4; a column with t twos has H_jj = 28 - 18t, so t <= 1: 14 columns with one 2 (H_jj = 10) and 4 with none (H_jj = 28); off-diagonal H_jk = 1 mod 9. With A = 7I+4J, det A = 7^14 * 9 and the matrix-determinant-lemma identity det(N)^2 = 7^10 det(H[S])/729 for |S| = B-V = 4 makes every 4x4 principal minor of H a perfect square (Connor 1952 method). Row relations at a type-1 column give exactly two H = 10, five H = -8 off-diagonal entries. Whether this closes is unknown; existence is not excluded.

exact_quantifiers.matrix: All 14x18 matrices over {0,1,2}; no automorphism, cyclicity, prescribed column types, distinct-column, resolvability or block-orbit assumption.
exact_quantifiers.equivalent_invariants: Row sum 9, row squared norm 11, seven ones and one two; column sums 7; MM^T = 7I+4J. Row sum alone and Gram matrix alone do NOT replace the fixed row-composition conditions.
exact_quantifiers.symmetries: Row/column permutations preserve existence. Further lexicographic, partition or orbit reductions require a written completeness argument before exclusion.

acceptance.existence: One strict-format full matrix (line 1: BTD 14 18 7 1 9 7 4, then exactly 14 lines of 18 space-separated 0/1/2 entries, final LF) passing the parent definition-first checker, two independently authored further checker routes, intended-reason controls, producer/seed replay.
